## Task documents by email

`scripts/agent/tasks-export.ts --notify` renders each UNAUTHORISED AgentTask as a markdown form and POSTs it here.

A task dictated into a ring has a goal and nothing else — no declared effects, no acceptance check — and CANNOT run until a person supplies them.

**Answer by editing the file, not the email.** Fill in `effect` and `done_when`, then run `scripts/agent/tasks-import.ts`. That turns the answers into PENDING facts. Accepting them in Reckons.AI is what authorises the task — nothing in this workflow does.

Webhook is Header Auth (same credential as capture).
